warm_definition: 100 burn-in queries per engine, then measured queries; service kept running, worker/metadata caches and OS caches warm
cold_definition: Turbofish server / Qdrant process restarted, no burn-in, first 20 queries measured. The metadata service stays up (it is a long-lived SSD-backed service, not part of the query process); OS page cache and MinIO are NOT dropped. Qdrant serves from local disk/mmap; Turbofish reads metadata from metad and vector shards from MinIO

dataset.ground_truth: exact brute-force cosine top-10 over all docs (numpy, no index involved)
